require "thinkthen"

# each ticket goes to the team its words name:
# billing, shipping, and account
teams = ["billing", "shipping", "account"]
["I was billed twice for one order.",
 "My parcel is a week late.",
 "I am locked out of my account."].each do |text|
  puts ThinkThen.choose("Which team owns this?", text, options: teams)
end
